title: Terry Lovelace and partner Toby never recovered

tellings.quote: gone Toby's gone he he uh Terry told me that he he literally he never fully recovered after their incident now he was not on duty they were simply on a camping trip

plain: In 1977 a man named Terry Lovelace and his partner, named only as Toby, went through some kind of incident on a camping trip. They were off duty at the time, and afterwards neither of them ever fully recovered, and Toby is now gone. Mario Woods, a guest on an episode about a nuclear guard's abduction story, passes this on as what Lovelace himself told him, as a sign of how deeply such an encounter can mark people.
